skills.name: LLM Alignment Method Comparative Evaluation
skills.description: Scans codebase for deprecated classes, methods, and properties from Spring Boot 2.x and removes or replaces them before upgrading to 3.0. Ensures all deprecated 2.x APIs are eliminated to prevent compilation failures and runtime incompatibilities in Spring Boot 3.0.
skills.skill_body:
Before upgrading to Spring Boot 3.0, identify and replace all deprecated Spring Boot 2.x classes, methods, and properties. Use IDE refactoring tools, grep/search patterns, or static analysis to locate deprecated API usage. Replace each deprecated item with its 3.0-compatible equivalent. Verify compilation succeeds without deprecation warnings.

## Objective

Eliminate all deprecated 2.x APIs to ensure compatibility with Spring Boot 3.0 where deprecated items have been removed.
## Applicable Signals

- Deprecation warnings in build output
- IDE deprecation markers in source code
- Planned Spring Boot 3.0 upgrade
- Dependency review phase complete

## Contraindications

- Codebase is already on Spring Boot 3.0
- No deprecated 2.x APIs are in use
- Upgrade to 3.0 has already been completed

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Scan codebase for deprecated Spring Boot 2.x classes, methods, and properties', 'detail': 'Use IDE search, grep, or static analysis tools to identify all usages of deprecated APIs from Spring Boot 2.x'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Document each deprecated item and its replacement', 'detail': 'Create a mapping of deprecated API to 3.0-compatible equivalent for each finding'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Replace deprecated classes and methods', 'detail': 'Update source code to use 3.0-compatible equivalents; use IDE refactoring where available'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Replace deprecated properties', 'detail': 'Update configuration files (application.properties, application.yml) to use new property names'}
- {'step': 5, 'action': 'Compile and verify', 'detail': 'Run full build; confirm no deprecation warnings and all tests pass'}

## Constraints

- Must complete before upgrading Spring Boot version to 3.0
- Requires access to full codebase for scanning
- All deprecated items must be replaced; removal alone is insufficient

## Cautions

- Some deprecated APIs may have multiple replacement paths; verify the correct 3.0 equivalent for your use case
- Replacement may require additional configuration changes beyond simple API substitution
- Test thoroughly after replacement to ensure functional equivalence

## Output Contract

- All deprecated Spring Boot 2.x classes, methods, and properties have been identified and replaced with 3.0-compatible equivalents. Codebase compiles successfully without deprecation warnings. Ready for Spring Boot 3.0 upgrade.
